edges.reason: msg.sender determines the result of the minters[msg.sender] require in mint.
msg.sender must equal governance for setGovernance to proceed.
msg.sender must equal governance for addMinter to proceed.
msg.sender must equal governance for removeMinter to proceed.
constructor assigns msg.sender directly into the governance state variable.
mint reads the minters mapping to authorize the caller.
setGovernance reads governance in the require and overwrites it.
addMinter compares msg.sender against the governance value.
removeMinter compares msg.sender against the governance value.
mint passes account and amount into the internal _mint operation.
constructor invokes _mint to create the initial seed round supply.
setGovernance writes the new value into the governance state variable.
addMinter performs a privileged write to the minters mapping.
removeMinter performs a privileged write to the minters mapping.
account parameter flows into the _mint recipient argument.
amount parameter flows into the _mint value argument.
the _governance parameter is written into the governance state variable.
the _minter parameter is used as the key of the minters mapping write.
the _minter parameter is used as the key of the minters mapping write.
_initSeedRound is used to compute the initial minted amount.

normalization_plan.reason: The account parameter only exists to feed the _mint call inside mint and carries no independent behavior.
The amount parameter only exists to feed the _mint call inside mint and carries no independent behavior.
The _governance parameter is only used to overwrite the governance state variable within setGovernance.
The _minter parameter is only used as the key of the minters mapping write inside addMinter.
The _minter parameter is only used as the key of the minters mapping write inside removeMinter.
